description: Directive Inondation - Territoires à Risque d’Inondation important (TRI) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Séries de données géographiques produites par le SIG Directive inondation du territoire à risque important d’inondation (TRI) de Guadeloupe et cartographiées aux fins de rapportage pour la directive européenne sur les inondations. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include TRI, Directive inondation, Zones à risques naturelles. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
